title: Athletic Circuit
description: 3-round full body circuit chaining squats, push-ups, planks and cardio for athletic fitness

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Moderate high knees
exercises.instructions: Knees to chest at a moderate pace

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Bodyweight goblet squat
exercises.instructions: Hands in front of chest, squat deep

exercises.name: Commando push-ups
exercises.instructions: Alternate between plank and push-up position

exercises.name: Forward lunges
exercises.instructions: Big step forward, back knee grazes the floor

exercises.name: Superman plank
exercises.instructions: In a plank, lift one arm and the opposite leg, alternate

exercises.name: No-push-up burpees
exercises.instructions: Drop down, jump feet back, return, jump up

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Face down, bring foot toward opposite hand by rotating

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
